04The studio

Founded by Aidan Poole, Relic Studios LLC specializes in motion graphics and AI-driven visuals for nightclubs, festivals, entertainment venues, and global brands. Blending creative direction with technical mastery, we deliver cutting-edge visual experiences designed for large-scale LED walls and live performances.

Founder

Aidan Poole (Relic)

Aidan Poole (Relic) is a Bay Area visual artist, creative technologist and founder of Relic Studios. His work spans 3D animation, live visuals, generative video and AI software.
